image.comfyConnectionHint: You can start an existing ComfyUI installation here or connect an external one. A compatible checkpoint is required. The reader's Illustrate action replaces the current scene only after a successful render.
image.samplerHint: Style affects the actual image prompt; sampler and scheduler settings change KSampler inputs. Non-default choices are verified against ComfyUI before generation.
image.vramHint: Check observed free VRAM with nvidia-smi. You can warn or block ComfyUI requests below a configured reserve. This does not estimate a checkpoint's actual memory requirements or stop other processes.
comfy.runtimeHint: Use an existing ComfyUI installation and its local Python environment. Noble AI manages only the processes it starts, without downloading code or launching ComfyUI just by opening Settings.
workers.connectionHint: Connect another PC or an eligible Colab session through a protected Cloudflare tunnel. Remote GPU inference handles narrative generation while story history stays on this computer.
workers.securityHint: The tunnel must authenticate all bearer requests. Noble AI rejects workers accepting invalid tokens. Only compatible LLM endpoints are supported; Colab is not started automatically and no files are shared.
world.editorHint: Explicitly update location, present characters, inventory, and facts. The narrator cannot silently promote assumptions into canon. Each turn stores a snapshot for restoring branches.
narrative.connectionPending: Settings saved; the engine is not responding yet.
narrative.modelPrepared: Model prepared: {{model}} · {{seconds}} s. You can begin your story.
narrative.modelsFound: Models found: {{count}}. Enter or select a model from the local catalog.
narrative.koboldHint: KoboldCpp GPU layers are configured in Runtime settings. Additional Top-K, penalties, and reasoning settings are not exposed by the current adapter.
narrative.openRouterHint: Requests go to OpenRouter and may incur charges. Save your key under Settings → Providers; vision and reasoning depend on the remote model.
narrative.workerHint: This model was activated under Network & Workers. The remote server manages its hardware; Noble AI sends only the authenticated narrative request.
narrative.prepareHint: “Prepare model now” runs a short inference only when you press the button; it does not add a turn to story history. The first load may take longer. This does not apply to remote OpenRouter APIs.
narrative.runtimeHint: Models installed from Model Hub need a local runtime. Ollama can load a model on generation, while KoboldCpp can be started from Noble AI. OpenRouter runs remotely, and workers use an authenticated external GPU.
narrative.inspectorHint: Inspect the exact messages prepared for the provider before generation. It includes private Creator context: use it only to inspect your own stories. It neither runs models nor saves turns.
narrative.estimatedTokens: {{input}} estimated input tokens + {{output}} reserved output tokens / {{windowTokens}} configured context-window tokens.
narrative.tokensHint: Token counts are estimated from characters, not the model's tokenizer. KV cache is not measured, and the provider does not guarantee the supported context length.
workers.benchmarkHint: This is one test request. For p50/p95 latency and sampled VRAM use the Colab notebook benchmark.
workers.metricsHint: Metrics reflect the latest probe, not continuous benchmarking. Refresh them using Test connection.
workers.tokenPlaceholder: Secret token with at least 12 characters

checkpoint.licenseInfo: Reported license: {{license}}. Revision: {{revision}}. Models requiring special access or lacking a verifiable hash are excluded.
checkpoint.emptyCatalog: No installable individual checkpoints with a published size and SHA-256 were found at the repository root.

reader.historySearchHint: Search older player actions beyond the recent-turn window. The results exclude private author secrets and AI-generated prose, and are limited to this branch.
reader.directorHint: Deterministically choose whether to reuse an imported background or suggest new artwork. Context includes location, time, weather, framing, and lighting; emotions do not change the background key. Previewing never runs a model.
reader.directorNote: The director recommends actions. Expressions and event illustrations require separate sprites or explicit generation. No image has been generated automatically. A caption-matched Creator Studio asset may take visual priority.
reader.imageHint: Illustrations are generated only when requested. Connect ComfyUI and configure a checkpoint under Settings → Images. Stories remain playable without images.
reader.layoutHint: Three views share the same saved turns. VN highlights artwork, Book prioritizes prose, and Chat separates player actions from narration. The selected view persists across restarts.
reader.shortcutsHint: When focus is outside an input: Alt+1 VN, Alt+2 Book, Alt+3 Chat, Alt+B backlog, Alt+H hide interface. Esc closes the backlog or restores the interface when shortcuts are enabled.
reader.noMatches: No matches in the loaded scenes.
reader.noSavedScenes: No scenes saved on this branch yet.
reader.rewindHint: A separate branch will be created from the selected turn. The original story and all later turns remain intact.
creator.sheetGridHint: A grid of five transparent cells in this order: neutral, joy, anger, sadness, surprise. The reader reuses each PNG without generating images when advancing.
creator.spriteGenerationHint: ComfyUI generates five separate portraits, one per request. Noble AI removes the background and rejects low-quality cutouts. Images remain drafts until you approve all five previews.
creator.lorebookHint: Store secrets, locations, and rules that activate when trigger words appear in player actions or recent scenes. This text is private to the narrator; each branch keeps its own copy.
creator.witnessHint: Included in narration only when an eligible witness is present in confirmed world state. Mentioning a character does not change their presence.
